  requires k <= 100

  ensures forall i in [0, len(r)) . forall j in [0, len(r)) . i != j ==> r[i] != r[j]
  ensures forall x in [0, 100) . (exists i in [0, len(r)) . r[i] == x) ==> (forall y in [0, 100) . (forall i in [0, len(r)) . r[i] != y) ==> count(nums, x) >= count(nums, y))
spec fun count(nums: seq<seq>, x: int): int
  decreases len(nums)
= if len(nums) == 0 then 0 else (if contains(nums[0], x) then 1 else 0) + count(nums[1..len(nums)], x)
spec fun contains(row: seq, x: int): bool

= if len(row) == 0 then false else row[0] == x or contains(row[1..len(row)], x)
